subject: planner: use expoBackoff for GROUP BY cardinality estimation when no … (#62813)
summary: Introduces a shared exponential-backoff helper and a new sysvar `tidb_opt_group_ndv_skew_ratio` to optionally blend conservative (max single-column NDV) and exponential-backoff NDV estimates for multi-column GROUP BY/JOIN/DISTINCT; default remains conservative (0.0).
